name: SignalSync
description:
Query and analyze your organization's workflow requests and process definitions directly in Claude. Filter requests by status, location, or assignee, summarize operational workloads, and explore form structures across your business processes — all through natural conversation.
Make SignalSync a native part of your Claude workflows while respecting your existing tenant permissions and security controls. Built for enterprise operations teams managing requests across multiple locations and departments.
Requires an active SignalSync account with access to at least one tenant. Contact your SignalSync administrator to ensure your account has the necessary permissions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SignalSync to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SignalSync to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.signalsync.cloud/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SignalSync MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SignalSync provides these MCP tools: query_requests and query_workflows_definition.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SignalSync?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SignalSync in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
SignalSync requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SignalSync is developed by Archibus Solution Center Romania. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
